comment: Event → possible narrator lines. Lines are picked at random per event. Audio files (assets/voice/) will map by line id later; V1 scaffold shows captions only.

game.start: Welcome to Jamaica, brethren! Touch di road!
Alright! Airport to Ochi — let's ride!
pothole.burst: Lawd — another pothole ketch yuh off guard!
tyre.fixed: Good to go, brethren — di tyre fix up!
dog.chase: Weh di dog yah come from?! Floor it, nuh!
Dog pon yuh bumper, brethren — drive!
Lawd! Di yard dog dem nuh play!
dog.bark: Di dog still deh deh, yuh know!
Lawd, di dog nuh give up!
goat.hit: Yuh lick di goat?! Farmer nah happy bout dat!
Noooo — dat a somebody goat, yuh know!
Aye! Di goat never do yuh nothing!
faith.pen.stop: Jerk chicken an' festival — di real ting! Tyre good now, brethren!
Yuh stop at Faith's Pen! Respect — dat is di authentic Jamaican experience!
Aye! Jerk chicken fix everyt'ing — tyre an' soul!
faith.pen.skip: Yuh pass Faith's Pen without stopping?! Brethren, dat is criminal!
Nuh bother, next time pull over at Faith's Pen — best jerk on di island!
